src_text: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Vatika dukͻa ƒe agbͻsͻsͻ nye 800. Eyae nye dukͻ xͻ ɖokui si suetͻ kekeake le xexea me.
base: Vatican City me tɔwo le abe 800 ene, eya ta eyae nye dukɔ si tsi tre ɖe eŋu wu le xexea me kple dukɔ si me ame agbɔsɔsɔme le ʋɛ wu le.
lora: Vatican City ƒe amewo le abe 800 ene. Eyae nye xexeame ƒe dukɔ sue si le ɖokuisinɔnɔ me kple dukɔ si me amewo le ʋɛ wu.

src_text: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Vatika vidzidziwo katã nye Roman Katolikotͻwo.
base: Roma Katolikowoe nye Vatikan-dua me nɔlawo katã.
lora: Dukɔ sia me tɔwo katã nye Roma Katolikotɔwo.

src_text: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
reference: Ati ƒomevi geɖewo le eme kuɖe eƒe yame ƒe nɔnɔme, anyigba kple kponyigba vovovowo ta.
base: Atikeƒomewo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme sɔ gbɔ ale gbegbe, elabena woƒe nɔnɔmewo to vovo, woƒe anyigbawo to vovo eye woƒe kɔkɔƒe hã to vovo.
lora: Atikeƒomewo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme le etɔxɛ, le eƒe nukuklimatɔwo ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, anyigbadzinu vovovowo kple kɔkɔƒe vovovoawo ta.

src_text: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Amazontͻsisia nye tͻ si ƒe dzidzime nye evelia eye eƒe lolome ne gãtͻ si le anyigba dzi. Exͻa tsi ƒe agbͻsͻsͻ si wu teƒe 8 abe tͻ gãtͻ evelia ene.
base: Amazon-tɔsisiae nye tɔsisi didi evelia kple gãtɔ wu le anyigba dzi, eye wòtsɔa tsi si le tɔsisi evelia si lolo wu la ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ gbɔ wu zi enyi.
